name: 雾蓝修身长款连帽羽绒服款
description: 长款连帽宽松廓形，修身不臃肿，通勤百搭两色可选

styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm paper white #F5F0E4 and fog blue #C7D3D6 flat panels for packshot and info screens, deep ink teal #24343A field reserved for the macro and closing screens, seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the compliance main image
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio light, gentle front-left key, low-contrast contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte paper-textured flat panels, no wood grain, no stone counter
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, single weight family, slim underline rules for emphasis
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circles only, single accent color #A85C32
styleLock.presentationRules: the long coat silhouette is always fully visible hood to hem; stable scale across the set; garment never clipped by the frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft urban outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper white #F5F0E4, fog blue #C7D3D6, deep ink teal #24343A and one burnt sienna accent #A85C32; soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and low-contrast contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icons and slim underline rules only; clean editorial outerwear photography mixed with minimal infographic blocks; the long coat silhouette stays fully visible hood to hem at a stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，长款廓形完整合规呈现
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, the long coat centered and squared to the frame, full silhouette hood to hem
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front key with fill, low-contrast contact shadow under the hem
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the garment fills the frame edge to edge vertically
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The long coat presented straight-on eye-level, front view squared to the frame, full silhouette from hood to hem centered on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF background. Bright even high-key studio light with a soft front key and a low-contrast contact shadow grounding the hem. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace reserved for copy. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no hanger hooks with brand marks, no props, no model, no extra text, no watermark, no cut-off hem, no colored cast on the white ground.

shots.intent: 一秒传达长款修身不臃肿的核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, garment on the left third of the frame
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle gradient falloff, low-contrast contact shadow
shots.props: one slim #A85C32 underline rule under the headline zone as the only graphic element
shots.whitespace: clear upper-left copy zone kept empty for the headline
shots.textZone: upper-left headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 above a short #A85C32 underline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The long coat shown at a slight 3/4 angle on the left third of the frame against a flat fog blue panel #C7D3D6. Soft front-left key light with a gentle gradient falloff and a low-contrast contact shadow. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, the upper-left copy zone stays empty for the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a short #A85C32 underline rule. Negative: no more than one claim, no dense body text, no fabricated warmth or fill-power numbers, no props covering the garment, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 放大短款显胖显矮的痛点，反衬长款修饰身形
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, both panels frontal and identical in crop and height
shots.lighting: left panel flatter and heavier, right panel the set's soft front-left key, matched exposure
shots.background: warm paper white #F5F0E4 on both panels divided by one hairline #24343A vertical rule
shots.props: none, the two garment silhouettes carry the contrast
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, panels are filled by the two silhouettes
shots.textZone: one short label strip 「{selling_point_2}」 centered under each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two matched panels with identical frontal camera and crop: the left panel shows a generic short boxy puffy coat silhouette reading bulky and proportion-breaking, the right panel shows {product} in its long clean silhouette reading lengthening, both rendered on headless garment forms with no person. Warm paper white #F5F0E4 on both panels divided by a hairline #24343A vertical rule. The product occupies 50-60% per panel, one short label strip 「{selling_point_2}」 centered under each panel. Negative: no real model face or body, no fabricated before-after body change, no mocking copy, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入通勤 walking 场景，展示长款实穿气场
shots.camera: side profile full-length walking pose captured at eye level, garment fully in frame
shots.lighting: soft morning daylight from the left, 5500K, gentle ambient bounce, soft ground shadow
shots.background: soft-focus cool-grey city sidewalk wall and pavement tinted toward #C7D3D6 with real depth blur
shots.props: one plain unprinted tote bag carried in the far hand, nothing covering the garment
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the environment is the co-star
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A full-length side profile walking pose captured at eye level on a soft-focus cool-grey city sidewalk wall and pavement tinted toward #C7D3D6, real depth blur behind. Soft morning daylight from the left at 5500K with gentle ambient bounce and a soft ground shadow. One plain unprinted tote bag carried in the far hand, not covering the garment. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable model face, face turned away or cropped above the chin, no hands distorted, no logos on the bag, no extra text, no watermark, no cluttered street signage.

shots.intent: 用微距证明面料肌理与车缝工艺，支撑质感信任
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, tight zoom on the quilted fabric folds and stitching line
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the upper left revealing the fabric weave and stitch relief, shallow depth of field
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the whole subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the quilted fabric folds and the stitching line. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Soft skimming light from the upper left reveals the fabric weave and stitch relief against a deep ink teal #24343A matte field. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fabric composition or weight numbers, no plastic-looking sheen, no extra text, no watermark, no props.

shots.intent: 讲清版型取向与尺码结构，消除合身疑虑
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle of the coat standing on the left half, dimension graphics drawn flat beside it
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, text remains readable
shots.props: thin #24343A dimension lines, one empty spec table with blank value cells, two thin-line numbered circles in #A85C32
shots.whitespace: right half reserved as clean layout field for the spec graphics
shots.textZone: right-half spec column with empty table cells labeled 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, values left blank for post compositing
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size and fit infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The coat standing at a slight 3/4 angle on the left half against a warm paper white #F5F0E4 matte board, thin #24343A dimension lines and two thin-line #A85C32 numbered circles drawn flat beside it. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame, the right half is a clean layout field holding an empty spec table with blank value cells labeled 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no invented measurements or size numbers, no dense body text, no unreadable tiny labels, no watermark, no fake logo, no model.

shots.intent: 呈现两色可选，让买家完成颜色决策
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, two coat variants side by side in identical pose and identical lighting
shots.lighting: even soft studio light identical across both variants, low-contrast contact shadows
shots.props: two small rounded color-name chips under the hems, letterless
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the pair fills the frame
shots.textZone: one letterless rounded chip under each variant with a short label 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 reserved for color names
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two coat variants side by side at a straight-on eye-level view in identical pose and identical even soft studio light with low-contrast contact shadows, on a flat fog blue panel #C7D3D6. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame overall, one letterless rounded chip under each variant carrying the short labels 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」. Negative: no lighting drift between the two variants, no silhouette change between variants, no invented color names beyond the placeholders, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 暗场收口聚焦单品，引导立即下单
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, the coat centered on the dark field with generous margin around the silhouette
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the upper left modeling the quilted panels, one gentle #A85C32-warm rim from the right edge
shots.props: one slim #A85C32 rounded CTA button placeholder below the hem
shots.whitespace: lower quarter kept clear for the CTA element
shots.textZone: lower-center CTA button reading 「{selling_point_3}」 with one short headline line 「{selling_point_4}」 above it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing promo of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The long coat centered at a slight 3/4 angle on a deep ink teal #24343A matte field, soft directional key from the upper left modeling the quilted panels with one gentle warm rim from the right edge in #A85C32. The product occupies 55-60% of the frame, the lower quarter stays clear holding a slim #A85C32 rounded CTA button reading 「{selling_point_3}」 with one short headline line 「{selling_point_4}」 above it. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdown timers, no glowing neon effects, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cut-off silhouette.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：panel-01 竖版蓝灰长款连帽外套平铺展示，侧栏含系列英文字标与「秋冬长宽风衣」文案，页脚有来源地区与新季字样；panel-02 设计解析版式（左文右领口细节图）+面料解析红色三图标横条（面料舒适/防皱耐磨/手感柔软做工精湛/透气性好等通用卖点）；panel-03 袖口/领子/下摆三宫格细节位 + 设计亮点 01 时尚领型设计（翻领）02 品质纽扣设计（修腰部修身效果）；panel-04 设计亮点 03 腰间腰带设计 + 产品信息表（品名呢子大衣、货号、尺寸 M/L/XL/XXL/XXXL、卖点立体剪裁立领设计、面料 100%锦纶、填充物 90%白鸭绒）+ 版型/触感/弹力/厚度指数条（宽松档）+素材站水印贴片与二维码；panel-05 三项指数条（软-较薄-微弹）+ 颜色展示两色：焦糖色、军黄绿 + 模特展示区；panel-06/07 大幅灰底占位模特图与品牌自述英文段；panel-08 会员招募角标与二维码（已剥离）。品类判定依据：源夹名为男装，但 panel-02/03 文案反复出现「轻松穿出过渡淑女感」「更显女神气质」「都市白领、名媛佳人常备单品」，panel-06 英文自述含 girl brand，且品名为长款连帽加絮外套、尺码到 XXXL、版型宽松——综合判定为女装/外套而非男装，改判依据为文案性别指向与款型证据。已剥离内容：英文系列字标与排版美术、素材站水印与二维码、会员招募角标、原文案原句、全部原文数值（面料与填充物百分比、货号、尺寸）均改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白表格占位；模特面部一律不入模板。与近似模版差异（对照 registry 女装/外套全部 6 件及相近女装/上衣、男装/上衣段，含 suite-nanzhuang-yuanglingyinhua-duanxiutxu 与 suite-nanzhuang-jinzhahuang-wangge-chenshan）：1) 色板全新——暖纸白 #F5F0E4 + 雾霭蓝 #C7D3D6 + 深墨青 #24343A + 赭橙 #A85C32，registry 女装/外套段已用杏橙 #F6C6A8、薰衣草紫 #A6A3D9、混凝土灰 #A8A6A0、燕麦灰蓝 #B5A695 等均不复用；2) 背景体系不同——暖纸白/雾蓝双色块平涂加深墨青暗场收口，区别于已有的混凝土墙、街拍实景、杏橙边框画布与淡紫拱形分层；3) 机位体系不同——以正面平视 + 侧身行走 + 正上方俯拍微距为节奏主轴，registry 近似件的 matched-panel/high 45 度组合不复用；4) 角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>DETAIL>VARIANT>CTA，痛点镜用无头人台廓形对照而非真人分屏，全套无 COMPARISON 与 TRUST 镜，与登记件序列均不同；5) 道具体系不同——仅素色无印托特包、空白规格表格与无字色名胶囊，宽檐帽/棒球帽/衣架/干花等登记件道具一律不用；6) temperature 三值均被女装/外套段占用（cool/warm/neutral 各有），本件取 warm，靠上述色板、背景、机位、角色与道具差异区分。
